messages:
Ellie: Morning! If anyone wants to add a tiny ornament to the office ficus, I'm doing a 5-minute decorating sprint at 11. Bring something small or a joke ornament. :deciduous_tree:
Marco: Count me in. I have a mini disco ball keychain that refuses to stop sparkling. :disco_ball:
Tess: I'll text the remote crew for ornament donations — maybe we can hang a few on the cameras for the all-hands. :satellite:
Devon: Also bringing cookies. Labeling them 'for humans only' because Larry the plant thief keeps stealing crumbs. :cookie: :eyes:
Ellie: Love it. Quick poll: do we want background music? React :one: for holiday pop, :two: for mellow lo-fi, :three: for nothing but the sound of tinsel.
Marco: :one: 80s holiday pop please.
Tess: :two: keeping me productive.
Devon: :one: for disco-ball synergy.
holiday-bot: Reminder: Office decoration policy requires no open flames and no extension cords across walkways. Please keep egress clear. :warning:
Ellie: Got it holiday-bot. Will keep the cords taped and use battery lights.
Tess: Remote teammates sent a tiny crochet snowflake and a hand-drawn card. I'll pin photos to the #all-hands thread after lunch. :heart:
Marco: If the ficus appreciates the disco ball, expect weekly glitter shedding. Consider this fair warning. :sparkles:
Devon: Cookie update: brought two types, ginger snaps and vegan peanut butter. First come first serve. :yum:
Ellie: Decorating sprint at 11 — meet by the kitchen table. Anyone running late can drop an ornament at my desk. Also, kudos to Tess for organizing the remote ornament drop! :clap:
Tess: Thanks! Also shoutout to Marco for rescuing the broken string lights last week. Hero energy. :trophy:
Marco: Aw shucks. Team effort. Anyone want to name the ficus? Suggestions: "Ficus Claus" or "Tony Branch".
Devon: Tony Branch forever. :joy:
Ellie: Tony Branch it is. See you at 11. I'll bring extra tape and tiny zip ties. :scissors:
